card.name: Conditionals in how-to steps
card.fires_on: Words like 'If', 'inserted', 'do' or 'indicates' in step-by-step instructions, where the next word is likely to say whether something was done correctly or properly.

modes.label: If-clause openers
modes.description: The word 'If' starts a conditional in instructions, such as adjusting a device when needed.
modes.example: (Figure 9).<< If>> necessary, adjust the position of the Delivery

modes.label: Verb in a how-to condition
modes.description: A verb inside an 'if you did it' clause about performing a technique.
modes.example: If you<< inserted>> the needle deeper than the bevel,

modes.label: Result indicator
modes.description: A word that says what a result shows about whether a step worked.
modes.example: A homogeneous white milky liquid<< indicates>> formation of sulfur hexafluoride
